scope: Read-only source audit of cloud portrait/research/render/statistics/repair/deployment/storage paths, plus local checksum and player pin call sites. No production failures intentionally triggered and no implementation changes made in this audit.

findings.title: Research caches pin URLs across resumed work without checking current content
findings.trigger: A public evidence document is corrected at the same URL, and research resumes or transcript blocks are refreshed.
findings.behavior: URL SHA remains the cache identity. Existing sources bypass fetch; CardHistory retains those sources while rebinding changed transcript blocks.
findings.impact: New cards can continue using stale evidence despite a fresh official transcript.
findings.recommendation: Retain immutable snapshots for a finished research run, but revalidate URL-backed sources on explicit source refresh and record a new content revision. Preserve old versions as evidence for old cards.

findings.title: Portrait publisher rejects legitimate replacements and even metadata-only updates
findings.trigger: Owner approves a replacement for an advocate ID already published, or provenance changes while image bytes stay identical.
findings.behavior: Idempotency requires both Git blobs to match exactly; any existing differing file produces a hard error. Website export precedes the GitHub step.
findings.impact: Archive remains stale; website can contain the new image while GitHub publication fails.
findings.recommendation: Allow explicitly approved revisions using normal Git commits and expected-current-content conflict checks. Treat identical images with updated provenance as metadata updates.

findings.title: Content-addressed card exhibits cannot be safely uploaded again
findings.trigger: A worker uploaded an exhibit and then lost its checkpoint, or enrichment runs again with the same exhibit.
findings.behavior: finish uploads to the same content-addressed path using a create-only storage API and does not handle an existing identical object.
findings.impact: An ordinary replay fails with HTTP 412.
findings.recommendation: Reuse identical existing bytes, as upload_preview and CardHistory already do. Preserve create-only conflict handling for different content.

findings.title: Source freshness check misses replacement audio at an unchanged URL
findings.trigger: The Court replaces audio bytes at the same MP3 URL while the transcript PDF stays unchanged.
findings.behavior: PDF is compared by content; audio is compared only by URL. The stored audio hash is not consulted against the official recording.
findings.impact: Source refresh reports current and retries alignment with stale prepared audio.
findings.recommendation: Revalidate official audio on explicit refresh or a source-related alignment failure, using content or trustworthy change metadata; avoid repeatedly downloading it during routine polling.

findings.status: reproduced at reference-library interface; no production occurrence asserted
findings.title: Reference-library signatures omit source revisions and can leave old originals behind
findings.trigger: A source PDF or its page metadata changes without changing extracted page text.
findings.behavior: The update signature covers only page number/text. source.json is not refreshed; an existing original.pdf is never replaced. Even when text changes, the old original can survive alongside new metadata.
findings.impact: Readers can see inconsistent source metadata and original PDF bytes.
findings.recommendation: Include source content revision and relevant page metadata in the signature, and replace the exported PDF when that source revision changes.

findings.title: Hand-maintained renderer checksums duplicate source truth
findings.trigger: A legitimate renderer edit does not also update presentation/sources.json.
findings.behavior: verified_source raises even for a comment-only edit. Repair validation also requires coordinated source/manifest edits.
findings.impact: Accepted renderer changes can fail at planning/preview time.
findings.recommendation: Generate and validate the manifest from the selected source during the build; keep run-specific renderer identity without a manually maintained second copy.

findings.status: source-level design risk, not a reproduced outage
findings.title: Static presentation assets are pinned remote runtime dependencies
findings.trigger: GitHub is unavailable, or a tracked font/logo is changed without updating the static asset manifest.
findings.behavior: Planning downloads seven static assets from an old commit and verifies their hashes.
findings.impact: Temporary GitHub failures block planning; new tracked assets remain invisible until separate manifest changes.
findings.recommendation: Package the matching static assets with the renderer at build time. Freeze that selected asset set in each render bundle rather than following latest assets mid-render.

keep: Hashes of approved/frozen render inputs, chunks, and final media prevent mixed revisions.
Per-edited-file repair preimages and immutable deployed image identities prevent applying a patch to the wrong code. Current v2 repairs already avoid unrelated whole-tree invalidation.
HMACs, OAuth PKCE, ETags/generation conditions, and worker leases serve authentication or concurrency; do not remove them as duplicate catalog checks.

watch_list.note: Spotify persisted-query hashes are third-party protocol operation IDs. They can age when the provider changes its frontend; they are not file-integrity checks. Thumbnail failures are caught and do not block video publication.
